description: For a reservation that reserve_slot returned with payment.required = true: returns the MPP payment link, the amount charged now, and the balance due at the visit. The agent pays it itself (HTTP 402 challenge, then the person's wallet credential); no code is sent to the customer for a paid booking. A booking that takes no payment through Advocate answers payment_required false with a detail, not an error, and, if not confirmed yet, is confirmed with confirm_booking and the customer's code.

reservation_id.description: The reservation_id reserve_slot returned with payment.required = true

name: create_booking_payment_link

balance_due_cents.description: Minor units due at the visit

detail.description: Present when payment_required is false: what to do instead, since no payment is taken through Advocate

expires_at.description: Unix seconds after which the reservation lapses unpaid

payment_link.description: POST here (no body) to receive the HTTP 402 MPP challenge

payment_required.description: true: payment for this booking is taken through Advocate; it may already be authorized or in flight, so ask for a new approval only if the pay route answers 402. Comes with payment_link, amount_cents, currency, kind, balance_due_cents, due_at_visit, expires_at and instructions. false: no payment is taken through Advocate for this booking, which does not mean the service is free. Comes with reservation_id and detail only.

title: Create Booking Payment Link
